clave: Three pillars: with the house, professional bankroll with units, and zero emotion.
resumen: The three pillars of the system: (1) align your picks with the house's exposure — win when the house wins; (2) professional bankroll management with a 1-to-10 unit scale; (3) total emotional detachment: no watching every game, no betting on feelings, no emotional hedging. The losing bettor is defined by having no system, betting random amounts, following the hype, chasing losses, and constantly switching systems.
